title: Summoning of the Demonic Path Commander
next_chapter_hook: When the two threads of Heavenly Fate intertwined in the Void, Chen Ji felt his consciousness being stripped away piece by piece—he must find the answer before the Tianji Record completely dissipates.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly solidified, and in those eyes that had witnessed countless eras, memories from ten thousand years ago emerged—he had once been the scribe of fate, inscribing the life and death cycles of countless souls. Chen Ji felt a strange power surge from the first page of the Tianji Record, pulling his consciousness toward some unknown direction. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind: 'Go, Chen Ji. The cause from ten thousand years ago should bear its fruit today.' Before his words even finished, Chen Ji felt the world spin, and in the next instant, his consciousness had been dragged into a chaotic Void.

dialogue.content: 'You've finally arrived, I've waited far too long.' A deep voice emerged from the depths of the Void, carrying an inexplicable sense of intimacy. Chen Ji looked around—here, there was no heaven, no earth, only endless gray mist flowing slowly. And in the center of the mist, a massive phantom sat cross-legged, its face bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, only appearing more ancient and profound.

text.content: 'What place is this?' Chen Ji steadied his mind, secretly channeling the power of the Tianji Record, yet found this space seemed shrouded by some special force, his ability to foresee the future greatly diminished. Mo Xiansheng's voice arrived at the right moment: 'This is the Twin Resonance Space, where your fate intertwines with the Heavenly Eye. No outside force can interfere. You must make a choice here—to merge, or to oppose.'

dialogue.content: 'Merge?' Chen Ji coldly laughed, 'You dragged me into this space just to say this?' The phantom slowly rose, its form flickering in the mist yet radiating a terrifying pressure. 'You're wrong, Chen Ji. It wasn't I who dragged you here, but the Tianji Record that brought us together. We were originally one, only forcibly separated into two parts.'

text.content: 'One?' Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, yet waves crashed in his heart. Mo Xiansheng had mentioned legends of twins but never that he and the Heavenly Eye shared such profound origins. The phantom seemed to see through his thoughts: 'Ten thousand years ago, your predecessor Chen Tianming and my predecessor Demon Venerable Zhonglou were twin siblings from the same source. We were both chosen by fate, yet due to the manipulation of Heavenly Will, we became sworn enemies. Chen Tianming used himself as bait to seal me; and he perished thereby, leaving only a remnant soul that reincarnated as you.'

dialogue.content: 'Chen Tianming...' Chen Ji murmured softly, the name stirring some strange resonance in his bloodline. The phantom continued: 'Do you know why he named you Chen Ji? Because 'Ji' is the Tianji, the key to destiny. Chen Tianming calculated everything, using ten thousand years to arrange matters, all so we would meet at this moment.' The phantom's tone carried complex emotions, 'He once saved my life—I still remember that.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt something within his mind crumbling. For ten thousand years, he thought he stood alone against fate, never knowing that from the very beginning, he was the most crucial piece on destiny's chessboard. And this demonic commander called the Heavenly Eye was actually his fated twin. 'What do you mean by merge?' He finally spoke, his voice steadier than expected.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's third choice facing destiny—to merge or to oppose?

choices.description: Accept the possibility of twin fusion, becoming one with the Demonic Path Commander, gaining complete Heavenly Fate power, but also losing part of the self.
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete Heavenly Fate power, shatter the heavens' chess game
choices.risk_hint: Once merged, there is no turning back

text.content: Chen Ji slowly extended his hand. 'If merging can grant us both freedom, then so be it.' A flicker of surprise crossed the phantom's eyes, followed by a relieved smile. The two silhouettes gradually drew closer in the mist, the Tianji Record within Chen Ji trembling wildly, as if agitated by this historic moment.

choices.description: Refuse the temptation of fusion, confront the Demonic Path Commander as Chen Tianming's heir, vowing to break this ten-thousand-year cycle of fate.
choices.visible_cost: Consume large amounts of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent self, prove that mortal flesh can also defy heaven
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's power runs deep and unfathomable

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, cold light flickering in his eyes. 'I am myself—not Chen Tianming, not anyone's copy! If you want to merge, ask if the Tianji Record in my hand agrees first!' The phantom sighed softly: 'As expected, you are as stubborn as he was ten thousand years ago.'

choices.description: Make no decision yet, first gather more information, clarify the true consequences of merging and opposing before making a choice.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the truth of the twin spirits
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander will not necessarily give you much time

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. "Before I make my decision, I need to know more. What is the cost of this fusion you speak of? And what are the benefits?" The shadow nodded. "A good question. That is the correct attitude." He began to explain the pros and cons of both choices in detail.

dialogue.content: "After fusion, we will no longer be two independent individuals, but a completely new existence." The shadow's voice carried a hint of seduction. "You possess Chen Tianming's strategic wisdom, while I have ten thousand years of cultivation. After fusion, we will have power enough to oppose the Heavenly Dao's will and completely break this chess game. And if you choose to resist..." His tone turned cold and murderous. "I will use every ounce of my strength to erase you, because your existence poses the greatest threat to me."

text.content: Chen Ji felt an overwhelming pressure emanating from the shadow, a crushing force of ten thousand years of accumulated power that could reduce any mortal to nothing. Yet his legs remained unwavering, unshaken. "Many have threatened me, but they are all dead." He sneered. "Do you think a few words can make me submit?"

choice.prompt: At this critical crossroads of destiny, Chen Ji must make the final choice

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Dao set us as opposites, I shall break this very setting. Rather than both being destroyed, let us merge into one.
choices.visible_reward: Become an existence that transcends the Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath. "Very well, I choose fusion. But you must promise me—after fusion, both our consciousnesses will be preserved." The shadow laughed heartily: "Refreshing! For ten thousand years, I've finally waited for a Chen family member who dares to make a decision!" The two silhouettes converged in the mist as the Tianji Record bloomed with unprecedented radiance.

choices.description: Chen Ji's fate is written by none other than himself; I will never accept any form of manipulation. Even the Heavenly Dao must make way for me.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Prove self-worth and obtain independent power
choices.risk_hint: Risk mutual destruction with the Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: A burning battle intent ignited in Chen Ji's eyes. "Since you refuse to give me a third path, then let us fight! What Chen Ji lacks least in this life is the courage to clash with fate!" The Tianji Record transformed into a phantom sword in his hand, pointing directly at the shadow. A flicker of admiration crossed the shadow's eyes: "Excellent! This is the son of Chen Tianming!"

Just as both sides reached the point of drawn swords, Master Mo's voice echoed once more in Chen Ji's mind: "Chen Ji, wait. Whatever choice you make, remember one thing—Chen Tianming chose to fall precisely to leave you a third path." Chen Ji's heart trembled. "What third path?"

dialogue.content: "Neither fusion nor resistance." Master Mo's remnant soul manifested in the void. "But coexistence. The twin spirits need not merge into one, nor must they fight to the death. You can use each other as mirrors, reflecting one another, finding balance through opposition. Chen Tianming schemed for ten thousand years under the watchful eye of Heavenly Dao's will, all to secure this sliver of survival for you."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faces the ultimate choice: fusion, resistance, or the third path?

choices.description: Establish a coexistence relationship with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, maintaining independence while depending on each other, pioneering an unprecedented new path.
choices.visible_cost: Must simultaneously endure the weight of two fates
choices.visible_reward: Obtain power that transcends both fusion and opposition
choices.risk_hint: The path ahead is unknown, no one has walked it before.

text.content: Chen Ji burst into laughter: "Excellent! Since Heavenly Dao wishes us to be enemies, then I shall do the opposite! From this day forward, we are no longer enemies, but a community of destiny!" The phantom was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter: "Wonderful! Wonderful! Chen Tianming, you have sired an excellent son!" The two figures stood facing each other in the mist, and an unprecedented power was born between them.

choices.description: Since the third path is so arduous, why not simply fuse, breaking all shackles with absolute power.
choices.risk_hint: May Lose Chen Ji's Original Memories and Emotions

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting the fusing power envelop him. When he opened them again, his pupils had gained an unfathomable light—the experience and wisdom of the ten-thousand-year Demonic Sect Commander. He looked down at his own hands, murmuring: "Is this... complete power?"

choices.description: I, Chen Ji, never walk the path others have laid out for me. Even if shattered to pieces, I must prove my own worth.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a Complete Self, Forge One's Own Path
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's power runs unfathomably deep

text.content: Chen Ji raised the war sword transformed from the Tianji Record high: "Come! Let me see just how much the ten-thousand-year Demonic Sect Commander is worth!" A hint of regret flickered in the phantom's eyes: "Pity, had you fused, you could have been invincible under heaven." With these words, his form dissolved into countless demonic energies, surging toward Chen Ji.

Yet at that moment, metamorphosis struck. The resonance space's gray mists churned violently as brilliant golden light burst from Chen Ji's body—the Tianji Record Fragment had unsealed partial power at the critical moment. Golden light collided with demonic energy, exploding into splendid radiance across the void. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being stripped away layer by layer, an unprecedented crisis gripping his heart. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently resounded: "Not good! The resonance space's time limit has arrived—you must decide quickly, or you'll be trapped here eternally!"

Chen Ji clenched his teeth, and at the moment his consciousness was about to be completely devoured, he made his final decision. He didn't choose fusion, nor did he choose resistance—instead, he chose coexistence. He intertwined his Heavenly Fate with the Demonic Sect Commander's Heavenly Fate using the Tianji Record as the medium, forming a strange equilibrium. The two consciousnesses gazed at each other in that final moment, the Demonic Sect Commander's eyes flashing with shock and admiration: "You actually achieved it... the third path."

The resonance space began to collapse, the gray mist gradually dissipating. When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he had returned to the secret chamber in the Tianqing Sect. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul had retreated into the first page of the Tianji Record, but he left behind one final words: "Well done, Chen Ji. From now on, your fate and the Heavenly Eye's shall be tightly intertwined. Whether fortune or misfortune awaits depends entirely on how you wield this newfound power." Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his hands—he could feel an unfamiliar yet formidable power within him, the Heavenly Fate shared from the Demonic Sect Commander.

At that moment, hurried footsteps came from outside the chamber. Su Qingyao's voice filtered through the door: "Chen Ji! Are you unharmed? I sensed an anomalous surge of powerful energy!" Chen Ji quickly suppressed his aura. When he opened the door, he saw Su Qingyao's face full of worry. Her eyes were slightly red—she had clearly rushed here in haste. "I'm fine." Chen Ji smiled faintly, but his heart churned with tumultuous waves. The Demonic Sect Commander's summoning, his father's scheme from ten thousand years ago, and that third path... What truth lay hidden behind all of this?

Su Qingyao keenly sensed the change in Chen Ji. Her gaze swept over him several times before finally fixing on those eyes that had become far deeper than before. "Your aura... has changed." Her voice carried a hint of probing. "What happened?" Chen Ji shook his head: "It's a long story. I'll tell you when the time is right." He raised his head to gaze into the distance, where an invisible pair of eyes seemed to be watching him in the sky—the gaze of the Heavenly Eye. From now on, their fates would be forever intertwined, never to be separated again.

Ye Qing's silhouette suddenly appeared at the chamber door, her expression carrying an unprecedented gravity. "Chen Ji, the Commander has just issued an order." Her voice was low. "From this day forward, the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path will observe a ceasefire with the Tianqing Sect. And I shall remain by your side as an emissary." Chen Ji's brow arched. Ye Qing continued: "The Commander says this is the first step of the 'Coexistence Agreement.' The grievances from ten thousand years ago shall be completely resolved in your generation." Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then smiled: "Interesting. It seems my 'brother' has finally come to his senses."

Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, and a subtle tension filled the space between the two women. Chen Ji keenly sensed this, sighing internally: "This is going to be trouble." Yet what troubled him even more was the newly acquired power within him slowly awakening—the change brought by coexisting with the Heavenly Eye. Each time he used the Tianji Record's power, the energy from the Demonic Sect Commander would automatically surge forth, creating an unprecedented amplification effect. But at the same time, he also felt a hidden worry—that power seemed to be slowly eroding his consciousness. If he couldn't control it in time, the consequences would be unimaginable.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again in his mind, carrying a hint of weariness: "Chen Ji, you've done well. But I must warn you—this path of coexistence is far more dangerous than fusion or resistance. Your two consciousnesses will influence each other. The longer it goes on, the more blurred the boundaries become. If you don't want to lose yourself, you must find a way to completely stabilize this state as soon as possible." Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: "What method?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "Go seek the 'Mirror of Heavenly Fate.' It is the final supreme treasure left by Chen Tianming ten thousand years ago. Only it can help you maintain independence within coexistence."

As the two strands of Heavenly Fate intertwined in the void, Chen Ji felt his consciousness being stripped away piece by piece—he must find the answer before the Tianji Record completely dissipates. Outside the secret chamber, the wind clouds stirred. The three great sects did not yet know that a transformation sufficient to overturn the entire cultivation world's landscape had already quietly begun. And Chen Ji, this formertrash disciple, stood at the forefront of the storm, facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges. The shadow of the Heavenly Eye watched him from afar, awaiting the first test after their coexistence...
